title: Dang Tribal Culture Trail, Museum to Meadow

stops.note: The decoder ring. Do it first

day_notes.note: Saputara-based: museum context, then hands-on Warli. Evening free at the lake.
Interior day via Ahwa. If your dates land in the week before Holi, drop everything for Dang Darbar at Ahwa, the district's cultural centrepiece.

notes: Photograph people only with consent; buy crafts from makers. March visitors should check Dang Darbar dates first and plan the whole trip around them.
